name: ccms
description: Cyber Café & Gaming Lounge Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w ccms-server" "npm run dev -w ccms-client"
scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -n server,client,electron -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w ccms-server" "npm run dev -w ccms-client" "npm run electron:dev -w ccms-client"
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w ccms-client
scripts.build: npm run build -w ccms-server && npm run build -w ccms-client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w ccms-server && npm run typecheck -w ccms-client
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck -w ccms-server && npm run typecheck -w ccms-client
